_comment: Release state per kernel and level. `release` kernels must stay within 1.15x the instructions per sample of the comparison, `dev` kernels within 1.50x; see docs/performance.md. A `waiver` names the open item in docs/open-items.md that tracks a limit that is not met yet; it never hides the numbers.

sse2.waiver: VOLK has no implementation for this level: its portable `generic` code is compiled once per instruction set and VOLK uses the one of the best machine (AVX2), so the comparison is not at the same instruction set

avx2.waiver: open item M13-1: floor(v + 0.5) rounding and NaN handling need about twice the instructions of the rounding-to-even conversion of VOLK
